# tuning kind

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:tuningKind`](gmeow-tuningKind.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/tuningKind>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)

The kind of tuning system (equal division, just intonation, well temperament, etc.). Functional: a [`TuningSystem`](../classes/gmeow-TuningSystem.md) is of exactly one kind; hybrid systems are modelled as multiple coexisting standpoints ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:TuningSystem`](../classes/gmeow-TuningSystem.md) -> [`gmeow:TuningSystemKind`](../classes/gmeow-TuningSystemKind.md); functional
